remarks: Welcome to Your Dream Home! Step into this beautifully appointed tri-level townhouse, nestled in the highly sought-after Sunrise Hill community of Norwalk. This sun-filled unit offers a seamless blend of comfort, functionality, and style. Main level highlights, gorgeous flooring throughout, spacious living room perfect for entertaining, eat in kitchen with sliders leading to your private rear deck and fenced-in yard, ideal for pets and effortless indoor/outdoor living, and a convenient half bathroom for guests. Upper Level Features: Two generously sized bedrooms, full bathroom, ample storage space with multiple closets. Versatile fully finished lower level is perfect for a home office, 3rd bedroom, gym, or family room. Community amenities You'll Love: In-ground swimming pool, tennis and pickleball court, playground, scenic walking paths. Unbeatable Location: Close to shopping, dining, golf courses, beaches, and boating, easy access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, Metro North, SONO, and surrounding towns like Darien, New Canaan, Westport, and Wilton. Assigned parking space directly out front of the unit, ample guest parking available. This home truly has it all-location, lifestyle, and comfort. Don't miss the opportunity to make this townhouse your next home!
